Use only while safely parked with the vehicle ON. Keep hands and objects clear of all windows.

This turns DiKey strip and key lighting OFF if connected, disconnects active CarPlay, turns head-unit Bluetooth OFF, turns climate OFF, closes all four windows, turns DRLs OFF, dims the instrument cluster to its minimum nonzero brightness, turns the HUD OFF, mutes media, then sends the car's Screen off shortcut command.

Headlights are controlled manually and are never changed by Camp Mode. Turn the headlights back on and visually verify normal lighting before driving.

Touch the screen to wake it and automatically end Camping Mode. Original cluster brightness and HUD power are restored first; remain in Park for these changes. Head-unit Bluetooth and the connected DiKey lighting are turned ON, even if previously off; the DiKey colours are preserved. Saved media volume and mute state and DRLs are restored; windows stay closed. Climate stays OFF, even if it was ON before camping; the saved climate profile is not reapplied. Turn climate on manually when needed. Media volume returns to its saved level even if adjusted during camping. CarPlay disconnects without forgetting the phone or changing Wi-Fi; reconnect it normally afterwards. Head-unit Bluetooth connections disconnect during camping; ESP32 Bluetooth stays on. Only media audio is muted. This does not keep the vehicle powered or monitor occupants.
Vehicle in Park. Control headlights manually. Wake the screen to end Camping Mode; windows stay closed and climate stays OFF.
Turn the headlights back on and visually verify normal lighting before driving.
